note: Custom error selectors are stable. Person B maps these selectors to human text; Person A must not rename them without announcing it.

errors.name: CommitmentMismatch
errors.text: The submitted transaction does not match the approved commitment.

errors.name: UnauthorizedRecipient
errors.text: The transfer recipient is not in the committed rules.

errors.name: UnauthorizedSpender
errors.text: The allowance spender is not in the committed rules.

errors.name: ExceedsSpendLimit
errors.text: The amount exceeds the committed spend limit for this transfer.

errors.name: ExceedsAllowance
errors.text: The requested allowance exceeds the committed ceiling.

errors.name: SelectorNotAuthorized
errors.text: This function was never authorized by the commitment.

errors.name: CodeHashMismatch
errors.text: The implementation bytecode does not match the approved code hash.

errors.name: NestedCallNotAuthorized
errors.text: A multicall child is not present in the commitment.

errors.name: StaleVersion
errors.text: A superseded proposal version was submitted for execution.

errors.name: AlreadyExecuted
errors.text: This proposal version has already executed.

errors.name: TimelockNotElapsed
errors.text: The timelock has not elapsed yet.

errors.name: WrongChain
errors.text: The commitment was issued for a different chain.

errors.name: ReentrancyDetected
errors.text: A re-entrant call was detected during execution.

errors.name: PostConditionViolated
errors.text: A post-condition reverted the transaction after the call.

errors.name: GuardianHalted
errors.text: The guardian halted this proposal during the timelock.

errors.name: UnknownSelector
errors.text: The calldata selector is not recognized by the decoder.

errors.name: ValueNotAllowed
errors.text: The transaction carries native value, which this proposal does not authorize.
